QUOTE: These are enabled with `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND` or `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_MEMSAN`. Suites without `TEST_CF_` annotations are skipped in those components.

WHY: The answer says verification uses valgrind/MemorySanitizer via test-only config macros. But it never says the facility is off by default or that it is explicitly not part of the library API.
